synopsis: ROS 2 is the current generation of Robot Operating System, common in robotics software, and part of the open-standard integration glue connecting heterogeneous simulation tools [f16240, f8715, f8335]. The corpus identifies integrations with CARLA, Isaac Sim, Gazebo and BeamNG; CARLA 0.10.0 added native support, whereas BeamNG.tech's Autoware/ROS 2 integration is community-provided and dated 2026 [f16240, f8465, f8506, f9031]. Gazebo with ROS 2 is explicitly supported, and Isaac Sim exposes ROS 2 alongside OpenUSD, including for its RTX sensors [f8708, f9018, f9073]. A lowest-cost example combines CARLA, Isaac Sim or Gazebo with Chrono and ROS 2, but low licensing costs come with the highest internal labor requirement and do not eliminate hardware or cloud costs [f16158, f16128, f8739].
